purpose: Compile-only diagnosis of runtime evidence selecting QR versus barcode execution.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_DYNAMIC_CAPABILITY_CHOICE_001.json').read_text())['goal']
try:
 out=m.compile_goal(goal,reg,pathlib.Path('.').resolve())
 print(json.dumps({'status':'COMPILED','parts':out.get('compiled_parts'),'actions':out.get('controller_actions')},sort_keys=True))
except Exception as e:
 print(json.dumps({'status':'FAILED','type':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e)},sort_keys=True))
print('DYNAMIC_CAPABILITY_COMPILER_DIAG_COMPLETE')
PY
